quiet_hours.rule: A step whose computed send time falls before 08:00 or at/after 21:00 recipient-local moves to 08:00 the same day, or 08:00 the next day when the step's deadline allows. Deadline steps move earlier to 20:00, never later into the night.

a2p.when_not_ready: Every set stays draft_only and the package warns that texts cannot send until A2P 10DLC is approved.

copy_rules: Deadlines come only from the launch calendar; never invent one.
One CTA per message; no link shorteners.
Copy stays under 320 characters before placeholder expansion (2 SMS segments).
A buyer exits abandoned_checkout at either step.

text_sets.trigger: Contact opts in to texts on the landing page or by keyword.
text_sets.exit: None. This is a one-message confirmation.

steps.purpose: Confirm the opt-in, name the sender, set frequency expectation, and give HELP and STOP before any promotional text.
steps.copy: {{first_name}}, you're in. {{business_name}} will text you about {{offer_name}}. Msg frequency varies. Reply HELP for help or STOP to opt out.

text_sets.trigger: Contact registered for the launch event or webinar.
text_sets.exit: Event ends, or contact texts STOP.
text_sets.build_note: Event-relative waits are not verified API payloads; use the managed-browser (Tier-4) rail.

steps.delay: 24 hours before {{event_start_at}}, clamped into quiet hours
steps.purpose: Day-before reminder with the access link.
steps.copy: {{first_name}}, {{event_name}} starts tomorrow at {{event_start_at}}. Details and your link: {{access_url}} Reply STOP to opt out.

steps.delay: 1 hour before {{event_start_at}}, clamped into quiet hours
steps.purpose: Hour-before reminder; highest open rate of the set.
steps.copy: {{first_name}}, {{event_name}} starts in about an hour. Join here: {{access_url}} Reply STOP to opt out.

steps.delay: 10 minutes before {{event_start_at}}, clamped into quiet hours
steps.purpose: Final nudge for the live room.
steps.copy: {{first_name}}, {{event_name}} starts in 10 minutes. Join here: {{access_url}} Reply STOP to opt out.

steps.delay: At doors_open_at, clamped into quiet hours
steps.purpose: Announce that the offer is live. One link, one price, no invented urgency.
steps.copy: {{first_name}}, doors are open: {{offer_name}} is live at {{price}}. Get it here: {{sales_url}} Reply STOP to opt out.

text_sets.exit: Contact purchases, doors_close_at passes, or texts STOP.

steps.delay: 24 hours before doors_close_at, clamped into quiet hours
steps.purpose: Deadline notice with the real close time.
steps.copy: {{first_name}}, doors close tomorrow at {{doors_close_at}}: {{offer_name}} at {{price}}. {{sales_url}} Reply STOP to opt out.

steps.delay: 2 hours before doors_close_at; if that falls outside quiet hours, 20:00 the same day
steps.purpose: Final call. Deadline is the only urgency; no extra scarcity.
steps.copy: {{first_name}}, last call. Doors close at {{doors_close_at}}. {{offer_name}} at {{price}}: {{sales_url}} Reply STOP to opt out.

text_sets.trigger: Checkout started and no purchase after 30 minutes.
text_sets.exit: Purchase at any step exits immediately; texts STOP exits the set.
text_sets.build_note: Guard each step with the buyer tag and re-check before send.

steps.delay: 30 minutes after checkout start, clamped into quiet hours
steps.purpose: Assume a technical issue first. Short, helpful, one link back to the saved cart.
steps.copy: {{first_name}}, your {{offer_name}} order is still open. Did something go wrong? Finish here: {{checkout_url}} Reply STOP to opt out.

steps.delay: 24 hours after step 1, only if no purchase and the cart is still open
steps.purpose: One benefit reminder plus an invitation to reply. No new pressure.
steps.copy: {{first_name}}, still thinking it over? Your {{offer_name}} order is saved at {{checkout_url}}. Questions? Just reply. STOP to opt out.

text_sets.trigger: Purchase completes, access is granted, or launch_at is reached for an access holder.

steps.delay: Immediately on access grant, clamped into quiet hours
steps.purpose: Deliver the access link and tell the contact to save the text.
steps.copy: {{first_name}}, here is your access link for {{offer_name}}: {{access_url}} Save this text. Reply STOP to opt out.
